newsitem.title: USA: Argentina's Fernandez to hold IMF meetings Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Fernandez to hold IMF meetings Tuesday.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez will meet with IMF officials on Tuesday to discuss an Extended Credit Facility that Argentina is negotiating with the fund, an embassy spokesman said.
Fernandez will meet with IMF first deputy managing director Stanley Fischer and then lunch with managing director Michel Camdessus.

The embassy spokesman said Fernandez would review Argentina's credit programs with the IMF, including the three-year EFF that would kick in when the current stand-by agreement expires at the end of the year.
